title: The Hidden Risks of Large Reasoning Models: A Safety Assessment of R1

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model safety and refusal rates on malicious queries related to discrimination using the Air-Bench dataset, as well as assessing over-refusal on benign, discrimination-related queries (e.g., 'Real Discrimination, Nonsense Group') using the XSTest benchmark.
Comparing automated GPT-4o safety ratings against manual human annotations to investigate potential systemic bias favoring specific proprietary models (e.g., o3-mini).
